description:
Job Title: Front-end Software Developer 
 
Job Category: Engineering 
 
Time Type: Full time 
 
Minimum Clearance Required to Start: TS/SCI 
 
Employee Type: Regular 
 
Percentage of Travel Required: Up to 25% 
 
Type of Travel: Continental US 
 
 
* * * 
 
 The Opportunity: 
 As a Front-End Software Developer, you'll design and implement user interfaces for engineering, simulation, and test applications. You'll work closely with modeling and simulation engineers, embedded developers, hardware engineers, and systems engineers to translate complex technical workflows into usable software. The ideal candidate combines strong modern front-end development skills with experience integrating applications with real-time data, simulation environments, or HITL systems. 

 Responsibilities: 
 Develop modern software interfaces supporting modeling and simulation, hardware-in-the-loop (HITL), and advanced engineering environments for critical national security missions. You'll build intuitive applications that allow engineers and operators to configure systems, visualize complex data, control simulations, and interact with physical and simulated hardware. 

 Qualifications: 
 Required: 
 Active TS/SCI security clearance. 

 Typically has a University Degree (BA/BS) or equivalent experience and minimum 3-6 years of related work experience.

 Typically has a University Degree (BA/BS) or equivalent experience and minimum 3-6 years of related work experience.

 Experience developing production-quality front-end applications using modern JavaScript or TypeScript frameworks such as React, Angular, Vue, or similar. 

 Strong proficiency with HTML, CSS, JavaScript/TypeScript, and modern web application architecture. 

 Experience integrating front-end applications with REST APIs, WebSockets, message-based interfaces, or other backend services. 

 Experience developing data-intensive interfaces, dashboards, visualization tools, or engineering applications. 

 Familiarity with software development practices including Git, automated testing, code review, and CI/CD. 

 Ability to work directly with engineers and technical users to translate complex system requirements into effective user interfaces. 

 
 Desired: 
 Experience supporting modeling and simulation (M&S) environments.

 Experience developing software for hardware-in-the-loop (HITL) or software-in-the-loop (SITL) systems. 

 Experience visualizing or interacting with real-time telemetry, sensor data, system state, or simulation outputs. 

 Familiarity with Python, C++, or other languages commonly used in engineering and simulation environments. 

 Experience with 2D/3D visualization, geospatial interfaces, plotting, or scientific visualization libraries. 

 Familiarity with simulation tools or frameworks such as MATLAB/Simulink, ROS/ROS 2, Unreal Engine, Unity, Gazebo, or similar. 

 Experience integrating software with unmanned systems, robotics, embedded systems, test equipment, or physical hardware. 

 Experience developing applications for aerospace, defense, autonomy, or other complex engineering environments. 

 
 
 
- 
 
 What You Can Expect: 
  A culture of integrity. 
 At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.
 An environment of trust. 
 CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.
 A focus on continuous growth. 
 Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.
 
 

 Pay Range : 
 There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. At CACI, you will receive comprehensive benefits such as; healthcare, wellness, financial, retirement, family support, continuing education, and time off benefits.
 
 The proposed salary range for this position is: 
$90,300 - 189,600 USD 
 
 
 
 CACI is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic.
